finding: Shopify Admin API 2026-10 inventory_shipment webhook payloads add inventory_transfer_id, directly linking a shipment to its related inventory transfer when one exists.
old_approach: Transfer-to-shipment linkage could require joining or inferring across datasets.
new_rule_or_hypothesis: For Shopify 2026-10+ inventory shipment event verification, prefer inventory_transfer_id as the direct linkage signal when present; do not infer a transfer link when it is absent.
test_or_metric: On a verified 2026-10+ store/event payload, confirm inventory_transfer_id and read back the referenced transfer before using transfer/shipment state in stock or fulfillment trust scoring.
failure_fallback: If API version or inventory_transfer_id is unavailable, mark TRANSFER_LINK_UNVERIFIED and retain the existing non-inferred fulfillment checks; no blind retry.
provenance: Official Shopify developer changelog, Inventory shipment webhooks include inventory transfer IDs, published 2026-10-01.
